ALTER PROC [DW].[SP_PBI_Exposures]
AS
BEGIN

DROP TABLE DW.PBI_Exposures;

WITH DIMCUSTOMERACCOUNT AS
(
    SELECT DCA.AccountID,DCA.CustomerSK,DCA.BANKSK,DCA.BRANCHSK,DCA.ACCOUNTSK,DCA.CustomerID,DCA.SourceSystemCode,DCA.CurrentIndicator,DCA.ValidStartDate 
    FROM DW.DIMCUSTOMERACCOUNT DCA
    JOIN DW.DimAccount DA ON DCA.AccountSK = DA.AccountSK
    WHERE DCA.SourceSystemCode = 'CCD' or DCA.SourceSystemCode = 'LNS' 
    GROUP BY DCA.AccountID ,DCA.CustomerID ,DCA.SourceSystemCode ,DCA.ValidStartDate ,DCA.CustomerSK ,DCA.BankSK ,DCA.BranchSK ,DCA.AccountSK ,DA.AccountOpenedDate,DCA.CurrentIndicator

)

SELECT 
    DCA.AccountId AS AccountID
    ,DCA.CustomerID AS CustomerID
	,DCA.CustomerSK as CustomerSK
    ,CASE WHEN DDC.GlobalCIF IS NOT NULL THEN REPLACE(DDC.GlobalCIF,'Global_CIF_','Entity_CIF_')
      ELSE CONCAT('Entity_CIF_', DDC.SourceSystemCode, '_', DDC.CustomerID) END AS EntityCIF
    ,DDB.BankID AS BankCode
    ,DDBR.BranchID AS BranchCode
    ,DDBR.BranchName AS BranchName
    ,DDBR.Area AS Area
    ,DDBR.Region AS Region
    ,DCA.SourceSystemCode AS Source
    ,DDP.ProductGroup AS ProductGrouping
    ,DDP.Productname AS ProductType
    ,CONCAT(DDP.ProductGroup,'-',DDP.ProductName) AS ProductDetails
    ,DDA.AccountOpenedDate AS OpenedDate
    ,DCA.ValidStartDate AS LastUpdatedDate
    ,CASE WHEN DCA.SourceSystemCode = 'CCD' THEN DFC.RelationshipExposure * .85
     WHEN DCA.SourceSystemCode = 'LNS'THEN FLRE.TotalRelationshipExposureProrated * .85 END AS RelationshipExposure
    ,CASE WHEN DCA.SourceSystemCode = 'CCD' THEN DFL.StatementBalance * .85
     WHEN DCA.SourceSystemCode = 'LNS'THEN FLOB.OutstandingBalanceProrated * .85 END AS StatementBalance
    ,CASE WHEN DCA.SourceSystemCode = 'CCD' THEN DFLC.CurrentCreditLimit * .85
     WHEN DCA.SourceSystemCode = 'LNS'THEN FLCL.CreditLimitAmountProrated * .85 END AS CreditLimit  
    ,CASE WHEN DCA.SourceSystemCode = 'CCD' THEN DFC.BusinessDateSK
     WHEN DCA.SourceSystemCode = 'LNS'THEN FLRE.BusinessDateSK END AS BusinessDateSK
     ,DDBR.BRANCHSK AS BranchSK
     ,DDB.BANKSK AS BankSK 
     ,DCA.CurrentIndicator as CurrentIndicator                   
INTO DW.PBI_Exposures
FROM DIMCUSTOMERACCOUNT DCA
    JOIN (SELECT CustomerSK ,GlobalCIF,SourceSystemCode,CustomerID FROM DW.DimCustomer) DDC ON DCA.CustomerSK = DDC.CustomerSK
    LEFT JOIN (SELECT BANKSK,BankID FROM DW.DIMBANK) DDB ON DCA.BANKSK = DDB.BANKSK
    LEFT JOIN (SELECT BranchID,BranchName,Area,Region,BRANCHSK FROM DW.DIMBRANCH) DDBR ON DCA.BRANCHSK = DDBR.BRANCHSK
    LEFT JOIN (SELECT ACCOUNTSK,PRODUCTSK FROM DW.DIMACCOUNTPRODUCT) DAP ON DCA.ACCOUNTSK = DAP.ACCOUNTSK
    LEFT JOIN (SELECT ProductGroup,ProductName,PRODUCTSK FROM DW.DIMPRODUCT) DDP ON DAP.PRODUCTSK = DDP.PRODUCTSK 
    LEFT JOIN (SELECT AccountOpenedDate,ACCOUNTSK FROM DW.DIMACCOUNT) DDA ON DCA.ACCOUNTSK = DDA.ACCOUNTSK
        LEFT JOIN (SELECT RelationshipExposure,BusinessDateSK,ACCOUNTSK FROM DW.FACTCARDSRELATIONSHIPEXPOSURE) DFC ON DCA.ACCOUNTSK = DFC.ACCOUNTSK
        LEFT JOIN (SELECT ACCOUNTSK,StatementBalance FROM DW.FactCardsOutstandingBalance) DFL ON DCA.ACCOUNTSK = DFL.ACCOUNTSK
        LEFT JOIN (SELECT ACCOUNTSK,CurrentCreditLimit FROM DW.FactCardsCreditLimit) DFLC ON DCA.ACCOUNTSK = DFLC.ACCOUNTSK
        LEFT JOIN (SELECT AccountSK ,TotalRelationshipExposureFull ,TotalRelationshipExposureProrated ,BusinessDateSK FROM DW.FactLoansRelationshipExposure WHERE BusinessDateSK IN (SELECT MAX(BusinessDateSK) FROM  DW.FactLoansRelationshipExposure )) FLRE ON DCA.AccountSK = FLRE.AccountSK
        LEFT JOIN (SELECT AccountSK ,OutstandingBalanceFull ,OutstandingBalanceProrated FROM DW.FactLoansOutstandingBalance WHERE BusinessDateSK IN (SELECT MAX(BusinessDateSK) FROM  DW.FactLoansOutstandingBalance )) FLOB ON DCA.AccountSK = FLOB.AccountSK ----NO DATA
        LEFT JOIN (SELECT AccountSK ,CreditLimitAmountFull ,CreditLimitAmountProrated FROM DW.FactLoansCreditLimit WHERE BusinessDateSK IN (SELECT MAX(BusinessDateSK) FROM  DW.FactLoansCreditLimit) ) FLCL ON DCA.AccountSK = FLCL.AccountSK ----NO DATA
GROUP BY
DCA.AccountId
,DCA.CustomerId
,DCA.CustomerSK
,DDC.CustomerID
,DDC.GlobalCIF
,DDC.SourceSystemCode
,DDB.BankId
,DDBR.BranchID
,DDBR.BranchName
,DDBR.Area
,DDBR.Region
,DCA.SourceSystemCode
,DDP.ProductGroup
,DDP.ProductName
,DDA.AccountOpenedDate
,DCA.ValidStartDate
,DFC.RelationshipExposure
,FLRE.TotalRelationshipExposureProrated
,FLOB.OutstandingBalanceProrated
,DFL.StatementBalance
,DFLC.CurrentCreditLimit
,FLCL.CreditLimitAmountProrated
,DFC.BusinessDateSK
,FLRE.BusinessDateSK
,DDBR.BRANCHSK
,DDB.BANKSK
,DCA.CurrentIndicator
END
